messages:
jess: Quick check-in: legal pushed back on our proposed credit model for burst credits. They want clearer failure modes and refund triggers documented. Need quick opinion.

noah: What were the specific legal concerns?

jess: Legal wants defined triggers for refund vs non-refund. E.g., if we throttle due to unrelated infra incident, refund. If customer misuses prewarm (keeps sessions long), no refund. Also want cap on refund liability.

hao: We should add a formal SLA exclusion list and a maximum refund cap per incident (e.g., up to 1x of the burst purchase). Also include proof-of-breach telemetry clauses.

legal-bot: legal-note: include objective metrics for breach: e.g., prewarm_slots_allocated==true AND observed_routing_failure_rate > 20% for >5min AND cluster_capacity_utilization < 80% => eligible for refund.

noah: That seems fair. Also add a troubleshooting / arbitration flow: customers file a claim within 14 days with request id samples; we auto-validate against telemetry and issue pro-rata refund if validated.

jess: I'll incorporate. Ops-bot: run backup canary after prewarm canary to gather telemetry retention.

ops-bot: backup-canary scheduled at 1770029500 UTC for telemetry retention test.

hao: Also suggest a small-rate limit for refunds to prevent abuse: max one refund claim per tenant per 30 days without manual review.

legal-bot: add that to the appendix. Also require customers to enable token-level telemetry to be eligible for automatic refunds.

jess: Action: legal will send markup on contract language by EOW, product will reconcile.

noah: One more: ensure billing prorates refunds within next invoice and that accounting has an export for refunds to reconcile.

jess: Noted, I'll loop in finance post-markup.

ops-bot: note: scheduled docs generation for prewarm refund logic at 1770030000 UTC.
